description: NaN (Not a Number) MUST raise CanonError.
input_repr: Python: {'n': float('nan')}  /  JavaScript: {'n': NaN}  /  IEEE 754: quiet NaN
input_json_note: JSON spec does not allow NaN. Implementations must construct this value programmatically.
notes: R5: NaN is forbidden. Accepting NaN would destroy determinism (NaN != NaN in IEEE 754).
